comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop; this record mounts a bicycle-tire bead into a rim channel without pinching the tube.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial driver/wrench countertorque; the record requires bimanual bead compression, slack management, and rolling over a flange.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained 90° opening over three cycles; the record checks a seated, leak-free tire, straight valve, and released hands.
comparison.reason: The mechanisms, manipulation, and observable outcomes differ meaningfully; all available versions provide sufficient rubric detail.
